title: Lexical Closures
description: Functions capture the environment where they are defined
code:
x = 10
addX = \y -> x + y
x = 99
addX 5

title: Curried Functions
code:
add = \x y -> x + y
addFive = add 5
addFive 10

title: Function Composition
code:
compose = \f g x -> f (g x)
double = \x -> x * 2
square = \x -> x * x
compose double square 5

title: Recursive Factorial
description: A named function can call itself
code:
factorial = \n -> if n == 0 then 1 else n * factorial (n - 1)
factorial 5

title: Fibonacci
code:
fib = \n -> if n == 0 then 0 else if n == 1 then 1 else fib (n - 1) + fib (n - 2)
fib 8

title: Map a List
description: Recursion over a list and a function argument
code:
map = \f xs -> if isEmpty xs then [] else cons (f (head xs)) (map f (tail xs))
map (\x -> x * 2) [1, 2, 3, 4]

title: Fold a List
description: Reduce a list using a supplied operation
code:
foldr = \f acc xs -> if isEmpty xs then acc else f (head xs) (foldr f acc (tail xs))
foldr (\x y -> x + y) 0 [1, 2, 3, 4]

title: Reverse a List
code:
append = \a b -> if isEmpty a then b else cons (head a) (append (tail a) b)
reverse = \xs -> if isEmpty xs then [] else append (reverse (tail xs)) [head xs]
reverse [1, 2, 3]
